name: powershell-watchdog
description: Monitor memory of pwsh processes owned by each local VS Code window on Windows.

commands.title: PowerShell Watchdog: Restart Editor Services Session…
PowerShell Watchdog: Restart Scheduled Session Now

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.enabled.description: Monitor pwsh instances launched by this VS Code window, its terminals and their child processes.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.mode.description: Editor Services may restart automatically; ordinary terminal and child pwsh instances generate alerts only. An editor restart can interrupt running commands.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.sampleInt.description: Delay between completed collections, in seconds.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.warningPr.description: Private committed memory warning threshold, in GiB.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.restartPr.description: Private committed memory restart threshold, in GiB.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.consecuti.description: Consecutive valid samples at or above the restart threshold.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.collectTi.description: Maximum time for session resolution and collection.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.restartTi.description: Deadline for a measured replacement session, including command execution.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.cooldownS.description: Stabilization delay following a measured replacement session.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.maxAutoma.description: Maximum automatic restart requests in a rolling hour, retained across reloads.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.deferWhil.description: Defer automatic restart while any PowerShell debug session is active.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.reportRet.description: Age limit for owned exported HTML reports, enforced when exporting.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.historyRe.description: Retain workspace history across VS Code sessions for this many days. Old owned segments are removed automatically.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.profile.description: Workload thresholds: development ×1, tests ×1.5, build ×2. Explicit per-process values take precedence.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.processTh.description: Optional absolute GiB thresholds by process kind. Warning must be below high/restart threshold. Ordinary terminal and child processes only generate alerts.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.deferWhil.description: Defer automatic Editor Services restart while shell integration reports a running command. Missing signals remain unknown.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.historyMa.description: Combined on-disk history budget in MiB. The oldest owned segments are removed first; the live dashboard keeps the latest 200 entries.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.reportMax.description: Combined HTML report storage budget in MiB, enforced before each export. A single report above this limit is rejected.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.growthWin.description: Rolling observation window for memory growth alerts. Collection gaps reset the series; history is capped at 1024 points per process.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.requireKn.description: Require an observed idle shell integration state before automatic restart. Editor Services often cannot provide it; in that case restart remains deferred.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.growthWar.description: Private memory growth alert in MiB over growthWindowSeconds, with at least three observations and 75% nondecreasing steps. This does not prove a leak.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.restartGr.description: Countdown before automatic Editor Services restart. Cancel, postpone or restart now; all final identity, memory and activity checks still apply. Zero disables the countdown.
